items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, I love to do that.

ctx.x: It was not easy but I have a proof of that some place. Every once in a while I, in the quiet of my chamber, I check it out with the earphones.
You’ve told me to this day that part of your practice routine is singing along with Sinatra records right?
Yeah, I love to do that.
